approvedBy: Dr. Nadeem Ahmed (consulted with Dr. Safiya Noorain)

base_rules.description: Healthy but active habit -> Reassure, with habit-cessation counseling
Normal variation, no active habit -> Reassure
Normal variation but active habit -> Reassure, with habit-cessation counseling
OPMD, no active habit -> Recheck in 14 days
OPMD with active habit -> Refer for biopsy
Suspicious for oral cancer -> Refer for biopsy
Suspicious for oral cancer with active habit -> Refer for biopsy

abstain_rule.description: Model not confident -> no automatic suggestion, dentist's clinical judgment

recheck_rules.description: Recheck shows worse -> Refer for biopsy
Recheck shows unchanged -> Refer for biopsy
Recheck shows improvement -> re-evaluate using this capture's own class and habits, same as a first visit
